name: Lia
source:
"Yeah. I wish to remain by your side, walking together with you, forever."

Lia stands among the "Fairy Brides," guardians of the Midyr Holy Church. Her battle prowess is second to none, earning her the title "Bride of the Rising Sun." True to her moniker, Lia commands powerful magic that radiates with blinding brilliance.

This girl's as straight as an arrow - earnest, just, and wears her heart on her sleeve. Yet, with her past a blank slate, Lia's a bit out of touch with the world. After losing her previous contractor in battle, she fell into a deep slumber within her ring. Now she's back in action, tagging along with [url=/c135123]Sreng[/url], who's proved he's got what it takes to be her new partner.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character.html]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her true name is Lumiaria.[/spoiler]
